subject.title: fix: avoid false stayed-stopped on launchd KeepAlive throttle

question: May restart health treat the current 10-second product throttle and loaded-service state as authoritative for every supported managed LaunchAgent, including supported upgrade states?
rationale: The real proof establishes the canonical current installer path, but repository policy treats setup and upgrade behavior as compatibility-sensitive and the branch does not inspect an installed legacy or customized plist.

options.title: Confirm invariant and merge
options.body: Confirm supported managed LaunchAgents use the canonical KeepAlive and 10-second throttle policy, then merge the bounded current implementation.

options.title: Read installed policy once
options.body: Prepare KeepAlive and throttle facts from the installed service definition before polling so legacy or customized supported values receive matching timing.

options.title: Pause for upgrade matrix
options.body: Hold the PR until canonical fresh-install and supported upgrade service definitions are compared on macOS.

recommendation.title: Confirm invariant and merge
recommendation.body: Confirm supported managed LaunchAgents use the canonical KeepAlive and 10-second throttle policy, then merge the bounded current implementation.
